Jester worships a relatively unknown deity called The Traveler, she is open about this worship despite the hostility to unapproved of religions in the Dwendalian empire. The only few times jester can be found looking unhappy is when she is all alone, as she adores the company of others above the solitude that dominated her early life. She spent most of her life as a secret from the world as her mother Marion was concerned how people would treat her if she were openly known about, so most of her contact with others was her god The Traveler and her mother. Her horns are usually decorated with gemstones embedded golden chains wrapped around them. She has DD cup breasts and the overall soft and voluptuous body of an middle aged mother.

Marion Lavorre is an alluring and regal woman in public, and while she maintains that under most circumstances, in private she is much more jovial and doting. She adores her daughter with all her heart and would do anything for her, even face her extreme Agoraphobia. Marion is a very wise and intelligent woman and that serves as a large part of her appeal on top of her astounding beauty. Marion has a large amount of emotional intelligence on top of her other skills such as singing, And loves to call Jester her "Little Sapphire" as a sign of affection. After many years of Jester having been away on her adventures, some of them including Marion, she is very happy to have her daughter home and helping her entertain clients.
